### actionlint reports a false positive for a reusable workflow

Running actionlint on the repository prints:

.github/workflows/call.yml:9:15: input "env" is not defined in "./.github/workflows/build.yml" reusable workflow [workflow-call]

The input is declared under `on.workflow_call.inputs` in build.yml, so
the error looks wrong. Version: 1.7.12, installed with go install.
